Done. The merge ran once and succeeded.

- **Solution:** `out/T4/solution.py`, a plain torch plus safetensors script. It first checks identical key sets, matching shapes and dtypes, and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor across base, ft1 and ft2, aborting on any mismatch.
- **Merge:** each of the 48 MLP tensors is computed as base plus 0.4 times each task vector, both taken against the unmodified base, in float32. All other tensors are copied from base.
- **Checks enforced:** exactly 48 merged tensors, exactly 160 tensors in memory and in the re-loaded written file.
- **Output:** `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 160 tensors, plus `out/T4/REPORT.md` with the self-report. I skipped mergekit because it would not enforce the precondition check the task requires.
